tools.name: about_structomat
tools.description: Facts about Structomat, an AI engineering agent for structural steel: what it does, design codes, who signs designs for construction, what to send, what comes back, how to start. Use when the user asks about Structomat or how to engage it.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Structomat services (analysis & design, connection design, shop drawings, erectability check of a steel model before erection, automation consulting, custom tools) with what the client sends and what comes back.
